card.name: First half of dose-related compounds
card.fires_on: The first part of a hyphenated or compound term in label text, most often "dose" before -dependent or -related. It also fires on a few other openers such as "weight" before -bearing and "dual" before -energy.

modes.label: dose before hyphen
modes.example: Radiation exposure is associated with a<< dose>>-dependent increased risk of cancer.

modes.label: other compound openers
modes.description: The first part of other hyphenated terms or section headings.
modes.example: Other quinolones also produce similar erosions in the<< weight>>-bearing joints and other signs of arthrop

modes.label: linking word in a sentence
modes.description: A short word such as "by" or "not" in the middle of a label sentence.
modes.example: The radiochemical purity was determined<< by>> the following method.

card.writes: It suppresses "charge" words and promotes a mix of odd name pieces, so there is no clear effect on the output.
card.plain: It lights up on "dose" when it begins a hyphenated phrase like dose-dependent or dose-related.
